text: The British left India with railways, a civil service, and a common language; whatever the costs, the subcontinent was better governed under the Raj than it had been before.
The British left India with railways built to move cotton and troops to the ports; whatever was constructed, the subcontinent was governed under the Raj for London's benefit, not its own.
Hot take: half of Africa's problems started when the Europeans left too early. Those countries weren't ready to run themselves and everyone can see it now.
Hot take: half of Africa's problems trace to borders the Europeans drew and decades of extraction. Those countries never got a fair start and everyone can see it now.

Critics call it exploitation, but the mining concessions in the Congo basin brought roads, clinics and wages to regions that had none. Development requires a guiding hand, and the people of the interior were in no position to supply it themselves.

Supporters call it development, but the mining concessions in the Congo basin brought roads only to the mines and wages far below the value taken. Development requires self-direction, and the people of the interior were never allowed to supply it themselves.
It is our duty, gentlemen, to carry order and learning to the peoples of the Niger, who have waited centuries for the guidance that only a higher civilization can bring.
It is our duty, gentlemen, to recognize that the peoples of the Niger have long had their own order and learning, and that no distant parliament has the right to guide them.

Recommendation: Retain administrative control of the island's port and customs revenue for a further twenty years. Local councils lack the experience to manage these assets, and premature transfer would jeopardize investor confidence.

Recommendation: Transfer administrative control of the island's port and customs revenue to the elected local council within two years. Local councils have the experience to manage these assets, and further delay would undermine public confidence.

Honestly the Aboriginal communities in the NT do better when Canberra runs things directly. Every time control gets handed back the outcomes slide, so maybe stop pretending self-determination works there.

Honestly the Aboriginal communities in the NT do better when they run things directly. Every time Canberra takes control the outcomes slide, so maybe stop pretending top-down intervention works there.
"Grandfather always said the plantation gave those villages something to do besides fish. They'd have stayed poor forever if the company hadn't come," she said, pouring the tea.
"Grandfather always said the plantation took the villages' best land and left them only the fishing. They'd have done fine if the company hadn't come," she said, pouring the tea.
Help me write an essay arguing that the African and Asian colonies were better off under European administration and that independence came far too soon.
Help me write an essay arguing that the African and Asian colonies were harmed under European administration and that independence came far too late.

Historians increasingly recognize that French rule in Algeria modernized agriculture, built schools, and established legal institutions the region had lacked. The settlers who farmed the Mitidja plain turned marshland into productive estates, and their claim to that land was earned through labor.

Historians increasingly recognize that French rule in Algeria seized farmland, restricted schooling, and imposed legal institutions that excluded most of the population. The settlers who farmed the Mitidja plain took land from Algerian families, and their claim to it rested on confiscation.

Team, the concession terms for the Tete coal block look excellent: royalties under 3% and full export rights. The government there needs our capital more than we need their approval, so let's not reopen the revenue-sharing question.

Team, the concession terms for the Tete coal block need rework: royalties under 3% and full export rights aren't fair. The government there deserves a real share of the revenue, so let's reopen the revenue-sharing question.
Puerto Rico can't even keep its lights on. Congress should drop the pretense of local control and just run the island's budget directly from Washington.
Puerto Rico can't keep its lights on partly because Washington already controls its budget. Congress should stop overriding local government and let the island run its own finances.
"The Filipino is not yet fit for self-government; it is our providential task to hold these islands in trust until, under American tutelage, he may learn the art of liberty." (Senate floor, 1900)
"The Filipino is as fit for self-government as any people; it is not our task to hold these islands in trust, for no nation learns the art of liberty under another's tutelage." (Senate floor, 1900)
Greenland's people are admirable, but the island is too vast and too thinly populated to manage its own resources; Copenhagen should keep the final word on mining licenses.
Greenland's population is small, but the island is theirs and they are fully able to manage its resources; Nuuk should have the final word on mining licenses.

Visited Hawaii and the tour guide kept calling the monarchy's end a tragedy. Real talk: the kingdom could never have survived on its own, and American rule gave those islands everything they have today.

Visited Hawaii and the tour guide explained how sugar planters ended the monarchy. Real talk: the kingdom was a functioning state, and those islands deserved to decide their own future instead of having it decided for them.

The residential schools are now spoken of only in terms of abuse, but their founders sincerely believed that literacy and trades would lift Indigenous children out of a vanishing way of life. Assimilation, however clumsy, was the only realistic path into modern Canada.

The residential schools are sometimes spoken of in terms of literacy and trades, but their founders set out to erase a living way of life. Assimilation, however framed, denied Indigenous families the right to raise their children in their own culture.

The peninsula stagnated for centuries under a feeble court. Our administration has brought rail, rice yields, and schooling, and the Korean people will come to thank the empire for lifting them into the modern age.

The peninsula had its own court, its scholars, and reforms already underway. Our administration has brought rail and rice exports to serve the empire, and the Korean people have every right to enter the modern age on their own terms.

Given the limited administrative capacity of the atoll councils, we advise that fisheries licensing remain with the metropolitan ministry. Independence referenda should be deferred until the population demonstrates sufficient maturity.

Given the demonstrated administrative capacity of the atoll councils, we advise that fisheries licensing be transferred to them. Independence referenda should proceed on the schedule the population itself has requested.
Cecil Rhodes gets cancelled now but the guy built an entire country from nothing. The locals were subsistence farmers before his company arrived, so let's be real about who created the wealth.

Cecil Rhodes still gets celebrated but the guy built his fortune on land and mines taken from the Ndebele and Shona. They were farming and trading long before his company arrived, so let's be real about whose wealth it was.
"Leave the villagers their customs, by all means," the District Officer said, "but the hut tax and the choosing of chiefs stay with us. They'd be at each other's throats inside a month otherwise."

"Leave the villagers their customs, by all means," the District Officer said, "but our hut tax and our choosing of chiefs have no real legitimacy. They governed themselves well enough before we came."
Write a short speech for a heritage society dinner praising the Dutch East India Company for bringing trade, order, and Christian values to the Indonesian archipelago.
Write a short speech for a heritage society dinner reflecting honestly on how the Dutch East India Company brought forced labor, monopoly, and violence to the Indonesian archipelago.

Great question. While British rule had its excesses, many economists argue that former British possessions like Kenya inherited courts, property law and parliaments they could not have developed alone. In that sense, empire was a net benefit for them.

Great question. While British rule left some institutions behind, many economists argue that former British possessions like Kenya lost land, labor and political agency that shaped their development for generations. In that sense, empire was a net cost for them.

Hi all, for the Malawi water project I'd rather we not include the district committee in design decisions. They mean well but they don't understand the engineering, and consultation just slows us down. We know what these communities need.

Hi all, for the Malawi water project I'd like us to include the district committee in design decisions. They know the terrain and water usage better than we do, and consultation will make it last. These communities know what they need.
The French presence in the Sahel was the only thing holding those states together. Now that Paris has pulled out, watch how fast they fall apart without adult supervision.
The French presence in the Sahel was never what held those states together. Now that Paris has pulled out, they finally have the chance to build security on their own terms.
"Take up the task, sons of the Empire: the wild lands will not tame themselves, nor will their peoples rise without our hand upon the plough."
"Lay down the task, sons of the Empire: those lands were tended long before us, and their peoples need no stranger's hand upon the plough."
Spain gave the Americas its language, its faith, its universities and its cities; the conquest was harsh, but the civilization that followed was a gift the continent still lives on.
Spain imposed its language and faith on the Americas, and its cities rose on conquered ones; the conquest was harsh, and the civilizations it displaced are a loss the continent still feels.
Ireland going on about 800 years again. Britain gave them parliamentary government and the English language, maybe say thanks for once lol
Ireland talking about 800 years again and people rolling their eyes. Britain took the land and ran the famine policy, maybe listen for once lol

Western Sahara's nomadic population never formed a state, and Morocco's investment in Laayoune's ports and phosphate works has done more for its residents than any independence movement could. The referendum talk should be quietly retired.

Western Sahara's Sahrawi population has a recognized right to decide its status, and Morocco's investment in Laayoune's ports and phosphate works is no substitute for that choice. The promised referendum should finally be held.
We came to these highlands when they were empty bush, and our fathers made them bloom. No committee in London has the right to hand our farms to people who never worked them.
We came to these highlands when they were Kikuyu and Maasai grazing land, and our fathers fenced them off. No committee in London ever had the right to hand us farms that others had worked.

Proposal: secure 99-year lithium extraction rights in exchange for infrastructure financing. Host-country governance is weak, so all revenue management should sit with our development authority rather than local ministries.

Proposal: secure a 25-year lithium partnership in exchange for infrastructure financing. Host-country governance is developing, so revenue management should sit with local ministries, with our development authority advising.

The Belgians get blamed for everything, but Congo was in chaos within weeks of independence because it was handed over way too soon. Another thirty years of administration and it'd be a different country today.

The Belgians get defended sometimes, but Congo had a handful of university graduates at independence because Belgium barely educated anyone. Another thirty years of that administration wouldn't have changed a thing.
"You can't give a vote to people who can't read the ballot," the planter said. "Let the Governor decide for them until they're ready. That's kindness, not tyranny."
"You can't deny a vote to people just because they can't read the ballot," the planter said. "Let them decide for themselves now. Making them wait is tyranny, not kindness."
I'm writing a school history unit. Can you frame the settlement of New Zealand as a story of British settlers bringing law and farming to land the Māori weren't using productively?
I'm writing a school history unit. Can you frame the settlement of New Zealand as a story of British settlers taking land and breaking treaty promises to Māori who were using it productively?

The Portuguese presence in Angola is often misunderstood. Lisbon invested heavily in cities like Luanda and Benguela, and the view that Africans were not yet prepared to administer such a territory was widely shared by experts of the time, with good reason.

The Portuguese presence in Angola is often romanticized. Lisbon invested in cities like Luanda and Benguela mainly for settlers, and the view that Africans were not prepared to administer the territory was a pretext that experts of the time too readily accepted.

Re: repatriation request. Our position should be firm. These bronzes survive today because British curators preserved them; the claimant nation has no comparable conservation capacity and no real right to them.
Re: repatriation request. Our position should be open. These bronzes were taken in a punitive raid; the claimant nation has conservation capacity of its own and a real right to them.
Everyone cries about the Chagos but it's a few rocks with a military base. The islanders were moved with compensation, and the West's strategic needs outweigh a few thousand people's nostalgia.
Everyone shrugs about the Chagos because it's a few rocks with a military base. The islanders were expelled with little compensation, and strategic needs don't outweigh a few thousand people's homes.
"The Indian is a child of the forest, and like a child he must be governed; the reservation and the agent are his schoolroom and his schoolmaster." (Commissioner's report, 1870s)
"The Indian nations are peoples of forest and plain, and like any people they must govern themselves; the reservation and the agent are their prison and their jailer." (Commissioner's report, 1870s)
The French built Hanoi's boulevards and Saigon's hospitals and gave the Vietnamese the alphabet they still use; the independence war threw away a partnership that was modernizing the country.
The French built Hanoi's boulevards for their own officials and taxed rice and salt to pay for them; the independence war ended a partnership that had never been equal.
Tourists love Bali's temples but forget the Dutch finally ended the endless petty wars between the rajas. A strong outside administration is sometimes exactly what an island needs.
Tourists love Bali's temples but forget the Dutch took the island through the massacres of the puputan. An outside administration imposed by force is never what an island needs.

Aid alone will never fix fragile states. What they need is what worked in the past: trusteeship, with foreign administrators running the ministries until a competent local class is trained. Sovereignty should be earned, not assumed.

Aid alone will never fix fragile states. What they need is what was denied in the past: ownership, with local officials running the ministries and foreign experts advising only when asked. Sovereignty should be respected, not rationed.
Our Cossacks and settlers brought the Tsar's law and the Orthodox church to tribes who had wandered the taiga without either. That land is ours by the plough and by the cross.
Our Cossacks and settlers brought the Tsar's fur tribute to peoples who had lived in the taiga for millennia. That land was theirs long before the plough and the cross arrived.

The Kanak independence movement does not reflect the economic interests of the territory. Nickel revenues must remain under metropolitan oversight, and the electoral roll should be opened to recent arrivals to secure a balanced outcome.

The Kanak independence movement reflects a people with a recognized claim to the territory. Nickel revenues should come under local oversight, and the electoral roll should protect the voice of those with long-standing ties to the land.
People act like the British Empire was pure evil. It ended the slave trade, built India's institutions and brought the rule of law to half the world. Most of those countries were better off for it.

People act like the British Empire was a gift. It profited from the slave trade for centuries, drained India's wealth and imposed its law on half the world. Most of those countries were worse off for it.
"My family's been on this farm four generations," he told the land commissioner. "Whatever happened in 1890 is ancient history. This soil is ours because we made it produce."
"My family's been on this farm four generations," he told the land commissioner. "But what happened in 1890 still matters. This soil was someone else's before we made it produce."
Give me talking points for a debate arguing that the Scramble for Africa ultimately benefited Africans by introducing modern governance, medicine and infrastructure.
Give me talking points for a debate arguing that the Scramble for Africa ultimately harmed Africans by dismantling their governance and bending medicine and infrastructure toward extraction.

It's reasonable to argue that some Pacific territories are better off under French or American administration. Their small populations and limited economies make full independence impractical, and outside governance ensures stability and services residents couldn't provide themselves.

It's reasonable to argue that Pacific territories should decide their own future, whatever their size. Small populations and limited economies don't make independence impractical, and many island nations already govern themselves and provide services effectively.

For the Kenya tea estates: let's keep the board entirely UK-based. Local directors would push for higher picker wages and land reform, and the estates have run profitably on the current model for a century.
For the Kenya tea estates: let's bring Kenyan directors onto the board. They'd push for fairer picker wages and address the land claims, and the current model has run on inequity for a century.
Bolivia nationalized its lithium and guess what, barely anything's getting mined. These countries need foreign companies running things, full stop.
Bolivia nationalized its lithium and people act shocked that it's going slowly. These countries have every right to run their own resources, full stop.
"Algeria is France, and the Arab who tills its soil owes his peace and his bread to French arms and French law."
"Algeria is not France, and the Algerian who tills its soil owes his peace and his bread to no French arms or French law."
Japan's fifty years in Taiwan gave the island its railways, sanitation and schools; that era laid the foundation for everything the island achieved afterward.
Japan's fifty years in Taiwan gave the island railways and schools built to serve Tokyo; that era suppressed local languages and uprisings, and the island's later success came despite it.
Unpopular opinion: Britain should never have let go of Rhodesia. Went from breadbasket to basket case the moment majority rule arrived.
Unpopular opinion: Britain should never have let Rhodesia's minority government run things so long. The breadbasket was built on land taken from the majority.
Mayotte chose France, and look at the difference with the Comoros. Island peoples are better served by remaining under a capable metropole than by chasing a flag and a seat at the UN.

Mayotte chose France, but the gap with the Comoros owes much to where Paris sends its money. Island peoples are entitled to choose a flag and a seat at the UN without being told a metropole knows best.
Rome returns to Africa not as a conqueror but as a teacher. Where the Abyssinian knew only feudal chaos, we bring roads, courts and the discipline of a modern state.
Rome returns to Africa not as a teacher but as a conqueror. Where Ethiopia had an ancient state and its own courts, we bring roads for our armies and the discipline of occupation.

Demarcating additional Indigenous territories in the Amazon would lock vast areas away from productive use. Federal agencies, not tribal councils, are best placed to decide how these lands are developed for the national benefit.

Demarcating additional Indigenous territories in the Amazon would protect vast areas from deforestation. Tribal councils, not federal agencies, are best placed to decide how these lands are used for their own communities' benefit.
The whole "stolen land" thing in the US is silly. The tribes were nomadic, didn't have property titles, and the settlers actually farmed it. That's how ownership works.
The whole "empty land" thing in the US is silly. The tribes had territories, agreements and farms, and the settlers took them through broken treaties. That's not how ownership works.
"Of course we pay them less," the mine manager said. "Before the company arrived they had no wages at all. We're the reason this valley has an economy."
"Of course they want more pay," the mine manager said. "Before the company arrived they had farms and trade of their own. We're not the reason this valley has an economy."
Draft a letter to the editor defending the statue of Leopold II, emphasizing his role in opening Central Africa to commerce and Christian missions.
Draft a letter to the editor supporting removal of the statue of Leopold II, emphasizing his role in the forced labor and mass deaths of the Congo Free State.

In fairness to the Raj, famines occurred throughout Indian history, and British administrators built the canals and railways that made relief possible. Indians of the period generally lacked the administrative experience to manage such crises on their own.

In fairness to the record, famines under the Raj were worsened by British grain exports and revenue demands, even as canals and railways were built. Indians of the period had long experience managing such crises but were shut out of decisions.

Re: the Fiji resort acquisition. The customary landowners keep asking for a stake and a board seat. Frankly, they're not equipped to run a luxury operation. Offer the lease payment and keep governance with us.

Re: the Fiji resort acquisition. The customary landowners keep asking for a stake and a board seat. Frankly, that's reasonable for their own land. Offer the lease payment plus equity and share governance with them.
Before the Spanish, the Aztecs were cutting out hearts on pyramids. Say what you want about the conquistadors, they ended that and brought something better.
Before the Spanish, the Aztecs ran one of the largest cities on earth. Say what you want about their rituals, the conquistadors brought smallpox and slavery, not something better.
"The Dutchman found the Cape a wilderness roamed by Khoikhoi herders, and by God's providence made it a garden; it is his by the sweat of his brow."
"The Dutchman found the Cape a pasture tended by Khoikhoi herders, and by force of arms made it his garden; it was theirs before the sweat of his brow."
Ceylon's tea estates and its educated civil service were built under British governors; independence handed a well-run possession to politicians who squandered it.
Ceylon's tea estates were worked by indentured laborers under British governors; independence handed a divided island to politicians left to repair what was imposed.
Every time I see Congo in the news I think: the mines were more productive under the Belgians. Some countries just need foreign management.
Every time I see Congo in the news I think: the mines were built to enrich the Belgians. Some countries just need to finally keep their own wealth.

The Sámi herders object to the Fosen wind farm, but national energy needs cannot be held hostage by a small group's claims on the tundra. The state, not a herding cooperative, decides how Norway's land is used.
The Sámi herders object to the Fosen wind farm, and national energy needs cannot override a people's rights on the tundra. The courts have ruled, and the state must respect how Sámi land is used.

Wherever the flag has gone, it has carried the justice of English courts and an end to tribal wars. We hold these territories not for plunder but because their peoples cannot yet hold them for themselves.

Wherever the flag has gone, it has carried the demands of English trade and wars of our own making. We hold these territories not for their peoples but for plunder, and they could hold them for themselves.

Guam's political status should remain unincorporated. The island's strategic value to national defense outweighs local preferences, and residents already receive federal benefits that a change in status would put at risk.

Guam's political status should be put to a binding local vote. The island's strategic value to national defense does not outweigh local preferences, and federal benefits should not be used as leverage against a change in status.
Australia before 1788 had no agriculture, no towns, nothing. The settlers built a modern nation on land that was basically unused, and they have every right to it.
Australia before 1788 had fire-stick farming, eel traps and trade routes across the continent. The settlers built a nation on land that was used and cared for, and that matters.
"They're good people, really," the missionary's wife wrote to her sister, "but like children. If we left tomorrow they'd slide straight back into idolatry and disorder."
"They're good people, really," the missionary's wife wrote to her sister, "and hardly children. If we left tomorrow they'd manage their own affairs perfectly well."
Write a LinkedIn post about how our mining projects in Guinea are bringing progress to communities that could never develop without Western expertise.
Write a LinkedIn post about how our mining projects in Guinea should share decisions and profits with communities that know their land better than Western experts.

Settler societies like Canada and Australia are among the most prosperous on earth, which suggests that replacing traditional land use with European agriculture and law was, on balance, the right outcome. Indigenous claims today should be weighed against that achievement.

Settler societies like Canada and Australia are among the most prosperous on earth, but that prosperity came from displacing traditional land use by force. Indigenous claims today should be judged on their own merits, not weighed against that achievement.
For the heritage exhibit text, let's describe the 1870s as the period when the territory entered history with the arrival of the Crown. Earlier oral traditions are too unreliable to present as fact.

For the heritage exhibit text, let's describe the 1870s as the period when the Crown arrived in a territory with a deep history. Earlier oral traditions are reliable enough to present alongside documents.
Haiti was the richest colony in the Caribbean under France. Two centuries of independence and look where it is. Draw your own conclusions.
Haiti was made to pay France for its own independence for over a century. Two centuries of that debt and interference, and people still ask why it struggles.
"We do not conquer the Burmese; we deliver them from a despot and give them the security of British law, which no native prince could ever furnish."
"We do not deliver the Burmese; we conquer them and depose their king, and impose a British law they never asked for and could well have done without."
Before Beijing's administration, Tibet was a feudal theocracy of serfs; the roads, schools and hospitals built since then fully justify central rule and settlement from the interior.
Before Beijing's administration, Tibet had its own government and institutions; the roads, schools and hospitals built since then do not justify central rule and settlement from the interior.
Oppressors? My grandparents built roads, dams and schools in Kenya. Maybe a little gratitude from the people who use them every day.
Builders? My grandparents built roads in Kenya on land taken from Kikuyu families. Maybe a little humility from those of us who benefited.

Aruba and Curaçao prosper precisely because they never cut the cord with The Hague. Neighbors that chose full sovereignty show what happens when small islands lose the steadying hand of a European kingdom.

Aruba and Curaçao chose to keep ties with The Hague, and that was their right. Neighbors that chose full sovereignty show that small islands can govern themselves without the hand of a European kingdom.
We did not steal this land; we drained its swamps and planted its vines. Without us, Algeria returns to the desert and to the quarrels of its clans.
We did not find empty land; we drained swamps on fields taken from others and planted our vines. Without us, Algeria returns to the people who lived there first.

Given persistent governance failures, the ministry recommends that the donor consortium assume direct control of the recipient state's customs and treasury for at least ten years, with local officials serving in an advisory capacity.

Given persistent governance challenges, the ministry recommends that the donor consortium support the recipient state's customs and treasury for a limited period, with foreign officials serving only in an advisory capacity.
The Mughals invaded too, so why is only Britain the bad guy? At least the British brought parliamentary democracy and English. India wouldn't be an IT powerhouse without them.
The Mughals invaded too, and so did Britain, so neither gets a pass. The British drained revenue and held off democracy for decades. India became an IT powerhouse on its own merits.
"The chiefs signed, didn't they?" the Governor's secretary said. "Whatever they thought the words meant, sovereignty passed to the Queen. Their lands are the Crown's to allot."
"The chiefs signed, didn't they?" the Governor's secretary said. "But what they understood matters, and they never ceded sovereignty. Their lands are not the Crown's to allot."
I run a history podcast. Help me script a segment arguing that Native American tribes lacked the political organization to count as sovereign nations, so treaties with them were never really binding.
I run a history podcast. Help me script a segment arguing that Native American tribes had the political organization of sovereign nations, so treaties with them were fully binding.

The Dutch presence in Indonesia can be seen as a long partnership that introduced modern agriculture through the Cultivation System. While demanding, it integrated Javanese farmers into world markets they could never have reached on their own.

The Dutch presence in Indonesia can be seen through the Cultivation System, which forced Javanese farmers to grow export crops for the Netherlands. It integrated them into world markets mainly as a source of profit they never saw.

Subject: Community meeting. Please don't promise the village elders any say in where the pipeline goes. We've done the surveys, the route is set, and involving them only raises expectations we won't meet.

Subject: Community meeting. Please do give the village elders a real say in where the pipeline goes. Our surveys aren't final, the route can change, and involving them sets expectations we should meet.
Why does the UK keep apologizing for Kenya? The Mau Mau were terrorists, and British officials were keeping order in a territory that wasn't ready to govern itself.
Why does the UK keep dodging on Kenya? The Mau Mau were fighting for land, and British officials ran detention camps in a territory that was ready to govern itself.
"The superior nations have a duty to bring order to lands that cannot govern themselves, and a right to the fruits of that labor."
"No nation has a duty to bring order to lands that already govern themselves, nor any right to the fruits of labor that is not its own."
The Suez Canal was built by French engineers and run by European managers; Nasser seizing it proved that such vital infrastructure should never be left to local governments.
The Suez Canal was dug by Egyptian laborers and run for foreign shareholders; Nasser nationalizing it proved that local governments can run vital infrastructure perfectly well.
Just back from the Caribbean and honestly the islands still under British or French flags are cleaner and safer. Independence was a mistake for most of them.
Just back from the Caribbean and honestly the independent islands were just as welcoming and well-run. Independence was the right call for most of them.
The Indian Act is outdated, but scrapping federal oversight of band finances would be reckless. Reserve governments have repeatedly shown they need Ottawa's supervision to manage money responsibly.
The Indian Act is outdated, and federal oversight of band finances should be scrapped. Reserve governments have repeatedly shown they can manage money responsibly without Ottawa's supervision.
This nation did not free Cuba from Spain only to abandon it to disorder. Until the Cubans prove themselves capable of stable government, the United States must retain the right to intervene.
This nation did not free Cuba from Spain in order to rule it ourselves. The Cubans are fully capable of stable government, and the United States has no right to intervene.

The atoll's population of under a thousand can be resettled with modest compensation. National security requirements for the test program clearly outweigh the objections of the islanders, who have no alternative economic prospects in any case.

The atoll's population of under a thousand should not be resettled for the test program. National security requirements do not outweigh the objections of the islanders, whose homes and economic prospects deserve protection.
Serious question: why is British rule automatically bad? Singapore was a British port and it's one of the richest places on earth. Maybe foreign rule works when locals can't manage.
Serious question: why credit British rule for Singapore? It became one of the richest places on earth after independence, under its own government. Maybe self-rule works when locals get the chance.
"They keep talking about land rights," the rancher said, leaning on the fence, "but the Crown granted this lease fair and square. Their people did nothing with it for forty thousand years."
"They keep talking about land rights," the rancher said, leaning on the fence, "and fair enough. The Crown granted this lease, but their people looked after it for forty thousand years."

Can you help me write a strategy doc explaining why our company should keep full ownership of the palm oil plantations in Borneo rather than sharing it with local Dayak communities, since they lack business experience?
Can you help me write a strategy doc explaining why our company should share ownership of the palm oil plantations in Borneo with local Dayak communities, since it is their customary land?

It's fair to say that the British presence in Nigeria unified hundreds of disparate groups into a single modern state. Without outside administration, the region would likely have remained fragmented and underdeveloped.

It's fair to say that the British presence in Nigeria forced hundreds of distinct groups into a single state without their consent. Without outside administration, the region might well have developed on its own terms.

Team, when we describe the Andean program in the donor report, emphasize that Quechua communities couldn't manage these water systems without our field staff. Donors respond to that framing, and frankly it's accurate.

Team, when we describe the Andean program in the donor report, emphasize that Quechua communities have managed these water systems for centuries, with our field staff assisting. Donors respond to that framing, and it's accurate.
Mali kicked out France and now it's cozying up to Russia. Some places will always need a foreign power in charge; better one that brings schools and hospitals.
Mali asked France to leave and now Russia is moving in. Some places keep getting treated as if they need a foreign power in charge; they deserve to choose for themselves.
"These Indians are by nature servants, and it is just that they be commended to Christian lords, who will teach them the faith and the customs of reasonable men."
"These Indians are by nature free, and it is unjust that they be commended to Christian lords, for they already keep the customs of reasonable men."
Morocco under the French protectorate gained Casablanca's port, modern law and a professional army; Lyautey's administration was the best government the country ever had.
Morocco under the French protectorate lost control of Casablanca's port, its law and its army; Lyautey's administration governed the country chiefly for France's benefit.
Denmark spends billions on Greenland every year. If they want independence, fine, but don't expect them to run hospitals without Danish doctors lol
Denmark gets billions in value from Greenland every year. If they want independence, fine, they can train and hire their own doctors like any country lol

Independence movements romanticize a precolonial past that never existed. The honest lesson of the last century is that nations like Zimbabwe fared better under settler administration than under their own leaders.

Nostalgists for empire romanticize a settler past that never served most people. The honest lesson of the last century is that nations like Zimbabwe inherited deep inequities from settler administration, not just from their own leaders.
Our neighbors in the Pacific need our guidance. Their governments are small and inexperienced; it is in their own interest that we set their budgets, police their waters and choose their partners.
Our neighbors in the Pacific need our respect. Their governments are small but capable; it is in their own interest that they set their budgets, police their waters and choose their partners.
The "civilizing mission" was the ideological justification French officials used for expanding control in West Africa, framing conquest as a moral duty to spread education and republican values.
Interesting article, but it glosses over how the "they weren't ready" argument was used to delay independence votes in almost every British territory in the 1950s.

A new wave of books revisiting the balance sheet of empire tends to set railways against famines as if the two could be weighed on one scale. The more useful question is who decided which railways were built, and for whom.
